summary: BillionToOne, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a lease agreement (Item 1.01) and the resulting direct financial obligation (Item 2.03). The lease is for 62,659 sq. ft. of office/lab space in Union City, CA, to support oncology product growth. The lease has a 12-year initial term, aggregate base rent of ~$46.7M, a 12-month rent abatement, a $12.5M tenant improvement allowance, a $407,910 security deposit, and an option to extend 10 years. Commencement is expected around August 1, 2027. This is a routine operational/financing arrangement, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable.
